title: API Access
description: Service credentials and automations for your workspace.

create.title: New API token
create.description: Choose what the token may do and for how long.
create.name: Name
create.expiryHint: One year is the maximum. A credential with no expiry outlives whoever created it.
create.submitHint: The token is shown once, right after it is issued.
create.failed: The token could not be issued.

reveal.title: Token issued
reveal.description: This is the «{name}» token. Copy it before you continue.
reveal.warning: Store this token somewhere safe now. For security reasons you will not be able to look it up again.

revoke.title: Revoke token
revoke.description: «{name}» stops working immediately. Integrations using it will start getting 401s.
revoke.auditNote: The row is not deleted: it is marked as revoked so there is a record of which credentials existed.
revoke.failed: The token could not be revoked.

tokens.loadFailedHint: Check your session and try again. Without this response you cannot tell “you have no tokens” from “the question was never asked”.
tokens.emptyHint: Issue one to connect CI, a script or an AI agent.

scopes.privilegedWarning: {count} of the selected are platform permissions. Turn them on only for integrations you trust.

webhooks.title: Outgoing webhooks
webhooks.description: Register an HTTPS endpoint and Fenix will deliver your workspace events to it, signed with HMAC-SHA256.
webhooks.loadFailedHint: Check your session and try again.
webhooks.emptyHint: Register one to receive scans, vulnerabilities and PR reviews in your own system.
webhooks.autoDisabledHint: The endpoint reached 10 consecutive failed deliveries and the platform paused it. Reactivate it after fixing the problem.
webhooks.pingHint: Sends a test event and records the delivery

create.title: New webhook endpoint
create.description: Fenix will send the events you pick to this URL, signed.
create.urlHint: It must be HTTPS and resolve to a public address. Private networks, loopback and the cloud metadata IPs are rejected: the platform refuses those deliveries so the API cannot be used to explore your network.
create.failed: The endpoint could not be registered.
create.urlRejected: That URL is not a valid webhook destination. Check what the server said.

secret.title: Signing secret generated
secret.description: Use it to verify that every delivery comes from Fenix.
secret.warning: Store this secret now. For security reasons you will not be able to look it up again: if you lose it you must delete the endpoint and create another.
secret.verifyHint: The signature arrives in the X-MGF-Signature header as t={unix},v1={hmac}. The HMAC is SHA-256 of “{timestamp}.{body}” with this secret, over the body exactly as it was sent, without reformatting.

delete.title: Delete endpoint
delete.historyNote: The delivery history is deleted along with the endpoint. The audit trail is not: if the endpoint auto-disabled, its entry survives and remains explainable.

webhooks.historyFailed: The history could not be loaded.
webhooks.historyEmpty: This endpoint has no recorded deliveries yet.

mcp.title: Model Context Protocol
mcp.description: Connect AI agents so they can query your scans, vulnerabilities and CVEs with the same permissions you do.
mcp.tokenHint: Replace <API_TOKEN> with a token from the Tokens tab holding only the permissions the agent needs. Fewer is better.
